question: Which of the following is monoatomic?
solution:
Correct Answer **Helium**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**__Concept:__

__
 
• An atom is any particle of matter at its most basic level which contains at least one proton. 
 
• Molecules are made up of one or more atoms. 
 
• Types of molecules are-
 
 
• Monoatomic molecules
 
• Diatomic molecules
 
• Triatomic molecules
 
 

Explanation:__

Monoatomic molecules:

__
 
• A molecule composed of just one atom, and lacking any covalent bonds. 
 
• The noble gases such as He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe, and Rn are monoatomic molecules.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**Diatomic molecules:

 
• Diatomic molecules are molecules that contain only two atoms bonded to one another.
 
• Examples are hydrogen, oxygen, etc.

Triatomic molecules:

 
• Triatomic molecules are molecules composed of three atoms, of either the same or different chemical elements.
 
• An example is ozone.
